text_block_list.text: During certain journey――

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ――Hey old-timer, you alright?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Here, eat this. Like they say, 
"travel needs companion, life needs kindness", right?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Never heard it? 
Haha! No big deal then!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, interesting spot. 
Why wedges driven around all these trees?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…I see, local Feb 14th ritual 
blessing couples on travels.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Pretty romantic. Y'know, 
Japan has Valentine's custom too――

text_block_list.name: Stego Student Fan A
text_block_list.text: Stego-senpai! Accept my feelings, please…!

text_block_list.name: Stego Student Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Chocolates packed with promise 
to support you forever! Please……!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
All gifts for Big Sis go in box. 
Leave letters with me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Right, 14th today…… 
No wonder feeling nostalgic.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Where did I put stuff from back then?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If recall right, old man gave me 
whole tool set――

Academy Valentine's Day filled 
with warmth, shy looks, bittersweet moments.
Yet on this very day I ——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Aaand there we go.
Soil should be just about ready now.
choice_data_list: Why are you out here levelling the soil…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, soil froze over during winter.
Gotta prep it like this first.
choice_data_list: No not that, why today of all days…?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's only meaningful because it's done
today. Ceremonies got conditions
you gotta meet first!
choice_data_list: Yeah, so then what's all this!?

text_block_list.text:
I stopped her to ask what
she was doing; turns out there was a
ritual she wanted to try after
hearing about it on one of her journeys.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Special ritual done on February 14th.
Seems couples use it to wish for blessings on journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
We're comrades on our ongoing
journey, right? Not bad idea to give it
a shot then.
choice_data_list: …Blessings for a journey …Sounds good

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Right? Knew you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Alright, soil is flat now. Let's start.
choice_data_list: What are the steps for this ritual?
What are the steps for this ritual?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Simply put, we're just planting
tree seed —— just few special
steps to follow.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
First, two participants drive
stakes around area where
they plant seeds.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then, take turns driving stakes in.
Whoever's turn it is
makes wish for journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, no need to overthink it.
Let's give it a go.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ……Hmm, guess I'll start by wishing for safe travels ahead.

I copied Stay Gold's actions, hammered
stake, voiced wish for our journey.
choice_data_list: For you to enter many thrilling races
For you to enter many thrilling races

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That, and —— journeys, y'know, gotta
be fun.
choice_data_list: For you to enjoy this journey freely
For you to enjoy this journey freely

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
——Hey, you're not making any wishes for
yourself, are you?

Her words made me realize it.
Wishing her journey goes well…
comes straight from bottom of my heart.
choice_data_list: I'm properly voicing my own wishes

text_block_list.text:
Lining up to strike stake again,
I announce my wish: "To walk beside you on
your Golden Journey…"
choice_data_list: $(scale 95)and, to forever watch over you by your side

text_block_list.text:
Lining up to strike stake again,
I announce my wish: "To walk beside you on
your Golden Journey…"
choice_data_list: $(scale 95)and, to forever watch over you by your side

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
For this journey —— to never end, no matter
where it leads.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Now that stakes form circle in
ground, we pick seed to plant.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Before long, roots run deep,
leaves flourish, wishes on stakes
come true. Tree will watch over our journey.
choice_data_list: It's amazing… What seed are we picking?
It's wonderful… What are we growing?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Sorbus aucuparia, rowan tree.
Says it watches over travelers so they don't get lost.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Can make jam or jelly with
berries too, so Chairwoman said okay
to plant at edge of field.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: We plant seeds and cover with soil.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Heheh, working together like this is best.
choice_data_list: You're right… Or perhaps

text_block_list.text:
Ritual where we wish together
for endless journey…
something about this feels……
choice_data_list: (Greater than a wish, it's moreso a prayer)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, covered top with fallen
leaves, so frost won't be issue.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hm? You alright, Trainer?
choice_data_list: No, it's nothing at all

text_block_list.text:
We finished ritual. Can
check on seeds another time.

"May our journey find happiness
from here on." If I silently
pray right now ——

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Anyone got chocolate～～!
Trick or Choco～～!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's with you, Golshi?
Valentine's and Halloween double combo?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Better hand over chocolate～～
Else we're going tuna fishing
on my Golden Valentine Vessel～!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, c'mon, Stego~?
Trick orーー
choice_data_list: H-H-Have this!

text_block_list.text:
I opened chocolate bag I had
on me and gave one to Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ohhhhhh! Bite-sized chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, you had chocolates
this whole time?
choice_data_list: Well… I thought of sharing them with you
Well… I thought of sharing them with you

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hmmm, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Confiscating this then.
Too bad for you, Golshi.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, leaving this
tree to you, Trainer.

Hearing that, I realized…
Stay Gold will probably be setting off
on journeys often from now on.

Totally carefree —— but that's just
how she is.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me, I'll become it's protector!
Leave it to me, I'll become it's protector!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Aah, thanks. Know you'll raise it
into great tree.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
……Hey, tree guardian. Looking
forward to seeing it grow big and strong.
choice_data_list: $(scale 95)So you can make jam or jelly from this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, course. When time
comes, let's enjoy it together.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
——Got one more thing to look
forward to on my journey.
(Grumble...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Fuhaha! What's that? Berries haven't even sprouted yet!
choice_data_list: S-S-Sorry……

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
True, hard work works up
an appetite——— ah.

Felt hard touch against lips,
then smelled sweet aroma
next second.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's.
——Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Though single chocolate
ain't gonna fill you up.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Let's go find something
tasty, Trainer!
